text: BS Computer Engineering Course Map 2026-2027, Semester 1 and 2. Semester 1: MATH 2413 or 2417 Calculus I (prerequisite: ALEKS 80% or MATH 2312); ENGR 2300 Linear Algebra for Engineers (pre- or corequisite: MATH 2413 or 2417); ECS 1100 Intro to ENGR & CS (First Year required); ECS 1210 Foundations in ENGR and CS I (First Year required); and two Core courses. Semester 2: MATH 2414 or 2419 Calculus II (prerequisite: MATH 2413 or 2417); PHYS 2325 and PHYS 2125 Mechanics and Lab (prerequisite: MATH 2413 or 2417; pre- or corequisite: MATH 2414 or 2419); ECS 1220 Foundations in ENGR and CS II (First Year required; prerequisite: ECS 1210); CE 1202 Intro to CE II (prerequisite: ECS 1100); and CE 2305 Discrete Mathematics I (prerequisite: MATH 2413 or 2417). ECS 1100, ECS 1210, and ECS 1220 are required in the first year; transfer students should see an advisor.

MATH 2415* Calculus of Several Variables (prerequisite: MATH 2414) appears between Semester 2 and Semester 3 on the BS Computer Engineering Course Map 2026-2027. MATH 2415 is taken ONLY after MATH 2414 and is not required for students who complete MATH 2417/2419. Summer is optional for MATH 2415, but may delay the critical path.

BS Computer Engineering Course Map 2026-2027, Semester 3 and 4. Semester 3: MATH 2420 Differential Equations (prerequisites: MATH 2415 or 2419, and ENGR 2300); PHYS 2326 and PHYS 2126 Electromagnetism & Waves and Lab (prerequisites: MATH 2414 or 2419, and PHYS 2325/2125); ENGR 3341 Probability Theory & Statistics (prerequisite: MATH 2414 or 2419; pre- or corequisite: MATH 2420); CE 2310 Intro to Digital Systems (prerequisite: CE 1202); and CE 2302 ECE Programming Fundamentals (prerequisite: ECS 1220). Semester 4: CE 2301 Electrical Network Analysis (prerequisites: MATH 2420 and PHYS 2326/2126); CE 3201 Fundamentals I Lab (prerequisites: CE 1202 and RHET 1302; pre- or corequisites: CE 3320 and CE 2301); CE 3320 Digital Circuits (prerequisite: CE 2310); CE 3345 Data Structures & Algorithms (prerequisites: CE 2302 and CE 2305); and a Core course.

BS Computer Engineering Course Map 2026-2027, Semester 5 and 6. Semester 5: CE 3311 Electronic Circuits (prerequisite: CE 2301); CE 3202 Fundamentals II Lab (prerequisite: CE 3201; pre- or corequisite: ECS 2390); CE 3303 Signals & Systems (prerequisite: MATH 2420); ECS 2390 Professional & Technical Comm (prerequisite: RHET 1302); CE 4370 Embedded Systems (prerequisite: CE 3320); and a Core course. Semester 6: CE 42XX Elective Lab (prerequisite: CE 3202; see catalog); CE 4304 Computer Architecture (prerequisite: CE 3320); a CE Technical Elective (see catalog); CE 3161 Social Issues & Ethics in Engineering; and three Core courses.

BS Computer Engineering Course Map 2026-2027, Semester 7 and 8. Semester 7: CE 4388 Senior Design Project I (prerequisites: ECS 2390, CE 3161, CE 3202, CE 3303, CE 3311, and CE 3320); CE 4348 Operating Systems Concepts (prerequisites: CE 3345 and CE 4304); a MATH Technical Elective (see catalog); a CE Technical Elective (see catalog); and a Core course. Semester 8: CE 4389 Senior Design Project II (prerequisite: CE 4388); two CE Technical Electives (see catalog); a Free Elective or MATH 2413; and a Free Elective (1-2 SCH).

Grade requirements for the BS Computer Engineering Course Map 2026-2027: C or better is required for all classes. The critical path courses are MATH 2413 or 2417, ENGR 2300, MATH 2414 or 2419, MATH 2415, PHYS 2325 and 2125, CE 1202, MATH 2420, PHYS 2326 and 2126, CE 2310, CE 2301, CE 3201, CE 3320, CE 3311, CE 3202, CE 3303, ECS 2390, CE 3161, CE 4388, and CE 4389. The remaining core curriculum consists of RHET 1302, GOVT 2305, GOVT 2306, two American History (060) courses, Language, Philosophy, and Culture (040), Creative Arts (050), and Social and Behavioral Sciences (080). FAST TRACK: students interested in taking graduate level courses as an undergrad should speak to an advisor.
